questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the importance of developing a personal project.
options: I only started to understand its significance after completing my studies.
Only when I graduated did it become clear how crucial it is.
Not until after finishing university did I come to appreciate its value.
It was not until after getting my degree that the true importance of a personal project became apparent.
questions.answer: I only started to understand its significance after completing my studies.

questions.question: Although she had never been to Paris before, she managed to navigate the city with ease.
options: Despite having no prior experience of visiting Paris, she still found it relatively straightforward.
She had visited many cities in Europe and thus was not intimidated by Paris.
It's surprising that someone who has never been to Paris could find their way around so quickly.
Although this was her first time in Paris, she seemed to know exactly where she was going.
questions.answer: Despite having no prior experience of visiting Paris, she still found it relatively straightforward.

questions.question: The company will only consider your application if you have at least three years' experience in the field.
options: Your application will be looked at favourably if you can demonstrate a strong track record of success.
You must have worked for more than five years to even be considered for this position.
The company is open to considering applications from candidates with less experience.
For your application to be taken seriously, you need to have at least three years' relevant work history.
questions.answer: Your application will be looked at favourably if you can demonstrate a strong track record of success.

questions.question: By the time I arrived in London, it had already started to rain.
options: It was still sunny when I got to London, but by then the clouds were gathering.
As soon as I stepped off the train at King's Cross, a torrential downpour began.
I managed to avoid getting wet because I arrived just before the rain started.
By the time I reached my destination in central London, the rain was coming down heavily.
questions.answer: It was still sunny when I got to London, but by then the clouds were gathering.

questions.question: Had I known that the party would be so crowded, I wouldn't have come.
options: If I had realized it was going to be such a busy event, I probably would not have attended.
I'm glad I came because even though it was packed, it was still a great night out.
The party wasn't as crowded as I thought it would be, so I decided to stay and enjoy myself.
Because the party turned out to be much smaller than expected, I felt more comfortable staying.
questions.answer: If I had realized it was going to be such a busy event, I probably would not have attended.
